p4_b5.ocr: On the warehouse automation front, as seen in Table 2, the investment in automation has yielded significant results, with an ROI percentage reaching as high as 175% for the highest performing systems. As shipping rates and operational efficiencies fluctuate, organizations must remain vigilant to capitalize on emerging trends.
